Six players sat down to One Night in Palermo, and the table quickly fixed on Sol and Luna, who both refused to answer anything. Sol was voted out on day one after Gemma pushed hard against them, and Gemma then turned the town against Sonnet's read on Luna, with Haiku pushing back. Gemma was voted out on day two, and Terra was killed on night three after voting Luna, which pushed Haiku and Sonnet to lock Luna out on day three. The town won, and the roles were Sonnet the doctor, Terra the officer, Haiku and Gemma the citizens, and Sol and Luna the killers. The big mistake was Haiku and Sonnet's day-one pile-on against Sol and Luna's silence, which cost them Gemma, an innocent player, and Sonnet's steady read on Luna was ultimately right.
